story.paragraph: A woman wearing a straw hat and a man in a dark t-shirt are at a food counter in a busy indoor market. Another man in a white shirt approaches them. The three greet each other, and the man in the white shirt shakes hands with the man in the dark t-shirt. They engage in conversation, with the woman talking and laughing while the men listen and respond. The man in the dark t-shirt eventually looks forward with a surprised expression.
story.summary: Three people greet each other and talk at a food counter in a busy indoor market.
